keyVerseDR: "Can the children of the marriage fast, as long as the bridegroom is with them?" (Mk 2:19)

level1.title: Happy With Jesus
level1.story: People asked why Jesus' friends did not fast. Jesus said, "While the groom is here, it's a happy time!" Being with Jesus brings joy.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus compare Himself to?
What makes you happy about Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for the joy You bring. Amen.

activity.title: Joy with Jesus
activity.intro: Draw happy faces: Jesus' friends rejoice that He is with them!

level2.title: New Wine, New Wineskins
level2.story: People asked Jesus, "Why do the disciples of John and the Pharisees fast, but Thy disciples do not fast?" Jesus answered, "Can the children of the marriage fast, as long as the bridegroom is with them?" He said the day would come when the bridegroom would be taken away, and then they would fast. Jesus said no one sews a new patch on an old garment. And no one puts new wine into old wineskins, but new wine into new skins.
level2.keyLine: Can the children of the marriage fast, as long as the bridegroom is with them?
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is Jesus called the Bridegroom?
What 'new wineskin' does your heart need?
actions: Let go of an old grudge
level2.prayer: Jesus, make my heart new for You. Amen.

activity.title: JOY acrostic
activity.intro: Being with Jesus brings joy! Write a line for each letter.

art.mainBrief: Wedding party with bridegroom; new wineskins
